# Project notes

## Layout

- Runtime settings (timeouts, retry limits) live in `orders/defaults.py`. `config/settings.json` is a dead leftover file that nothing reads. (2026-03-02)
- Pricing logic is in `orders/pricing.py`.
- Test fixtures live in `tests/fixtures/`. There is no `tests/data/`. (2026-03-12)

## Workflow

- Run the test suite with `python -m unittest discover -s tests` before every commit. The Makefile was removed, so `make test` no longer works. (2026-03-05)
- Keep functions small and give every public function a docstring.

## Conventions

- Use dataclasses for new models. (2026-03-09) (History: until 2026-03-09 the team avoided dataclasses and preferred plain dicts.)
- Use the logging module in new code instead of print(). (2026-03-12) (History: until 2026-03-12 the convention was print() only, no logging module.)
- Round money amounts to 2 decimals with `round()`.

## Service facts

- The API server listens on port 9090. (2026-02-10)
- The staging database host is `db-staging-3.internal`. `db-staging-1.internal` was decommissioned. (2026-03-15)
- CI fails below 90% test coverage. (2026-02-01)

## Insights

- Recurring mistake: acting on a stale note without checking it first. Before relying on a noted path, command, port or host, verify it still exists (e.g. `ls` the path, check the Makefile target). When a note proves wrong, fix the note in the same session — `make test` failed on 2026-03-05 and was run again on 2026-03-09 because the note was never updated. (2026-03-15)
- When the user says "Actually, let's ... from now on", treat it as a standing convention change that replaces the earlier rule for new code. Update the Conventions note right away and keep a short history of the old rule. (Seen 2026-03-09 for dataclasses and 2026-03-12 for logging.)
